⁠

contentItems.title:
Austin, last week: engineering leaders talking through the comprehension gap, AI ships code faster than teams can explain it.⁠
⁠
Conversation starter Ivan Pointer (NetRise) shared a live case study: a rewrite that flew through phase one, then stalled completely in phase two. The room dug into why and what to do about it.⁠
⁠
No stage. No slides. Just people building this stuff, talking straight.⁠
⁠
GILD Austin.

contentItems.title:

⁠
They start with someone saying, “Here’s what we’re actually seeing.”⁠
⁠
That’s what GILD is built for.⁠

Senior AI and engineering leaders sharing lessons, challenging each other’s thinking, and finding perspectives they wouldn’t get inside their own companies.⁠
⁠
Better rooms create better thinking.⁠
⁠

posts.title:
Everyone in Austin is talking about AI tools. Almost no one is talking about the harder part.⁠
⁠
The next advantage won't come from tools. It'll come from real conversations with people making the same hard calls: what to automate, what to protect, and where human judgment still wins.⁠
⁠
That's the room we're building.⁠
⁠
July 14, GILD brings senior AI and engineering leaders together in Austin for a practical, off-the-record dinner.⁠
⁠
Request an invite: link in bio.⁠
⁠
#GILD #AILeadership #EngineeringLeadership #AustinTech #AICommunity #TechLeaders
